changes.disclaimer: Revenue in EUR millions per Deloitte's 2024 Money League (matchday + broadcast + commercial); excludes player-transfer income.
changes.trivia: Real Madrid became the first club to break the 800M EUR barrier and reclaimed the top spot from Manchester City after opening the remodelled Santiago Bernabeu.

changes.disclaimer: Points calculated using 3-points-for-a-win retroactively across all La Liga (Primera División) seasons since 1928-29.
changes.trivia: Real Madrid and Barcelona are the only clubs to have played in every La Liga season, and are the only two to have crossed the 5,000-point mark.

source.name: Wikipedia — La Liga all-time top scorers by club

changes.disclaimer: Total goals scored in La Liga (Primera División) regular-season matches since 1928-29.
changes.trivia: Barcelona edges Real Madrid by roughly 36 goals despite Real winning more titles — a legacy of Barca's high-scoring Cruyff and Guardiola eras.

changes.disclaimer: Seasons played in France's top flight (Division 1 through 2001-02, Ligue 1 thereafter) since its 1932-33 inception.
changes.trivia: Olympique de Marseille is the only French club to have been relegated to the second tier and come back to hold the all-time seasons record.

changes.disclaimer: The Cup Winners' Cup ran from 1960-61 to 1998-99 before being folded into the UEFA Cup; 17 clubs share the single-title tier.
changes.trivia: Barcelona is the only club to have won the Cup Winners' Cup four times — in 1979, 1982, 1989, and 1997 — the last edition before the trophy was retired.

changes.disclaimer: Total seasons in Spain's top flight (Primera División / La Liga) from its 1928-29 inception through 2024-25.
changes.trivia: Athletic Bilbao, Barcelona, and Real Madrid are the only three clubs never to have been relegated from La Liga.

source.name: The FA — FA Cup finals history

changes.disclaimer: Combined FA Cup final appearances (winners plus runners-up) since the competition's first final in 1872.
changes.trivia: Arsenal and Manchester United are tied on 22 FA Cup final appearances, but Arsenal leads the trophy count with 14 wins to United's 13.
